title.zh: 卷316 列傳一百三 瑚尔起 爱隆阿 巴灵阿 舒明 福禄 齐里克齐 阎相师 伊柱 努三 乌勒登
title.en: Volume 316 Biographies 103: Hu Er Qi, Ai Long A, Ba Linga, Shu Ming, Fu Lu, Qi Likeqi, Yan Xiangshi, Yi Zhu, Nu San, Wu Leideng
title.raw: 卷316 列傳一百三 瑚尔起 爱隆阿 巴灵阿 舒明 福禄 齐里克齐 阎相师 伊柱 努三 乌勒登

sentences.zh: 列傳一百三 瑚爾起愛隆阿弟巴靈阿舒明福祿齊里克齊 閻相師伊柱努三烏勒登 瑚爾起，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Biographies 103: Hu Erqi, Ai Long'a, younger brother Ba Ling'a, Shu Ming, Fu Lu, Qi Likeqi, Yan Xiangshi, Yi Zhu, Nu San, Wu Leideng. Hu Erqi was of the Guwalgiya clan, a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 103 — Hu Erqi, Ai Long'a, his younger brother Ba Ling'a, Shu Ming, Fu Lu, Qi Likeqi, Yan Xiangshi, Yi Zhu, Nu San, and Wu Leideng. Hu Erqi, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 自筆帖式累遷協領。

translations.literal: From clerk he was promoted in succession to assistant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from clerk through successive promotions to assistant commandant.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，從征金川。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he joined the campaign against Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Qianlong reign he took part in the Jinchuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 遷呼倫貝爾總管。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be commander at Hulun Buir.
translations.idiomatic: He was then appointed commander at Hulun Buir.

sentences.zh: 二十年，從征準噶爾，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he joined the Dzungar campaign and was given the rank of deputy military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he joined the Dzungar campaign and was granted the rank of deputy military governor.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，從參贊大臣達爾黨阿自珠爾都斯逐捕阿睦爾撒納，诇知阿睦爾撒納竄哈薩克，從定邊左副將軍哈達哈以師臨之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he followed Grand Councillor Da'erdang'a from Zhulduis in pursuit of Amursana, learned that Amursana had fled into Kazakh territory, and marched with the assistant frontier general on the left, Hadaha, to confront him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he followed Grand Councillor Da'erdang'a from Zhulduis in pursuit of Amursana; when scouts reported that Amursana had fled into Kazakh lands, he marched with Assistant Frontier General Hadaha to bring the army against him.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克汗阿布賚拒戰，擊敗之，斬百餘級，得馬二百餘。

translations.literal: The Kazakh khan Abulai refused battle; they defeated him, beheaded more than a hundred, and captured more than two hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: The Kazakh khan Abulai refused to fight; they routed his forces, took more than a hundred heads, and seized over two hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 獲其頭人，言阿睦爾撒納方在泥雅斯圖山，檄阿布賚擒獻。

translations.literal: They captured his leaders, who said Amursana was then on Niyastu Mountain; they sent orders for Abulai to seize and deliver him.
translations.idiomatic: They captured Kazakh leaders who reported that Amursana was on Niyastu Mountain and sent orders demanding that Abulai seize and hand him over.

sentences.zh: 杜爾默特貝勒巴圖、伯羅特等潛通阿睦爾撒納，瑚爾起與戰輝巴朗山，執伯羅特，盡殲其部眾，及阿睦爾撒納所留烏梁海五十餘戶。

translations.literal: The Dorlod beile Batu, Borot, and others had secretly communicated with Amursana; Hu Erqi fought them at Huibolang Mountain, seized Borot, annihilated all his followers, and also the more than fifty Uriankhai households Amursana had left behind.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorlod beile Batu, Borot, and others had been in secret contact with Amursana; Hu Erqi fought them at Huibolang Mountain, captured Borot, wiped out their entire following, and destroyed the more than fifty Uriankhai households Amursana had left behind.

sentences.zh: 沙喇斯、瑪呼斯既降复叛，掠台站，而布魯古特台吉琿齊等戕察哈爾總管巴寧阿以叛。

translations.literal: Shalas and Mahus had surrendered and rebelled again, plundering courier stations, while the Burut taiji Hunchi and others slew the Chakhar commander Baning'a in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shalas and Mahus, having surrendered, rebelled again and raided courier stations; meanwhile the Burut taiji Hunchi and others killed the Chakhar commander Baning'a and rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 上命瑚爾起偕鄂實、三格副哈寧阿，將千人駐濟爾哈朗、巴里坤適中地，捕琿齊及沙喇斯、瑪呼斯部眾。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Hu Erqi to accompany Eshi and Sange as deputies to Haning'a, with a thousand men stationed midway between Jierhalang and Barkul to capture Hunchi and the followers of Shalas and Mahus.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Hu Erqi, with Eshi and Sange serving under Haning'a, to lead a thousand men and garrison the midway point between Jierhalang and Barkul in order to capture Hunchi and the bands of Shalas and Mahus.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起偕鄂實追剿扎哈沁逃賊，又偕副都統巴圖濟爾噶勒自呼斯坦至尼勒喀河，偵琿齊等百餘戶游牧，突擊，執之。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi with Eshi pursued and suppressed fleeing Zahachin bandits; he also with Deputy Military Governor Batujiergale from Khustan to the Nileka River reconnoitered the pastoral encampments of Hunchi and others, more than a hundred households, made a surprise attack, and seized them.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi joined Eshi in pursuing Zahachin fugitives, then with Deputy Military Governor Batujiergale marched from Khustan to the Nileka River, found the pastoral camps of Hunchi and more than a hundred households, launched a surprise attack, and captured them.

sentences.zh: 尋從師自伊犁逐剿諸回部，至善塔斯巔，招降布魯特頭人圖魯啟拜、鄂庫及其部眾，搜捕阿里瑪圖河逸賊。

translations.literal: Soon he followed the army from Ili in pursuit through the Muslim domains, reaching Shantasi Ridge, where he received the surrender of the Burut leaders Turuqibai, Eku, and their people, and hunted fugitive bandits along the Alimatu River.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed the main army from Ili in the pursuit through the Muslim territories as far as Shantasi Ridge, where he received the submission of the Burut leaders Turuqibai and Eku along with their followers, and hunted down fugitive rebels along the Alimatu River.

sentences.zh: 上以索倫兵從征久，召瑚爾起及副都統鄂博什率以還，瑚爾起等仍請從軍。

translations.literal: Because the Solon troops had been on campaign long, the Emperor summoned Hu Erqi and Deputy Military Governor Eboshi to lead them back; Hu Erqi and the others still asked to remain with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Solon troops had been on campaign for so long, the Emperor recalled Hu Erqi and Deputy Military Governor Eboshi to lead them home, but Hu Erqi and his men still begged to remain with the army.

sentences.zh: 將軍兆惠攻霍集占於葉爾羌，被圍，定邊右副將軍富德檄瑚爾起及巴圖濟爾噶勒率索倫兵自伊拉里克赴援，以馬駝未至，負糧械步行戈壁中。

translations.literal: General Zhao Hui was besieging Huojizhan at Yarkand; the assistant frontier general on the right, Fude, summoned Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to lead Solon troops from Yilalik to the relief, but as horses and camels had not yet arrived they carried grain and weapons on foot across the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: General Zhao Hui, attacking Huojizhan at Yarkand, was surrounded; Assistant Frontier General Fude on the right frontier summoned Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to lead Solon troops from Yilalik to the rescue. Because horses and camels had not yet arrived, they carried grain and arms on foot across the Gobi.

sentences.zh: 上獎諭，即授正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: The Emperor commended him in an edict and immediately appointed him Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised him in an edict and at once appointed him Mongol deputy military governor of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 師至巴爾楚克，兆惠圍已解，與富德軍合。

translations.literal: When the army reached Barkul, Zhao Hui's siege had already been lifted, and they joined Fude's forces.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the army reached Barkul, Zhao Hui's siege had already been raised, and they united with Fude's command.

sentences.zh: 霍集占之徒阿卜都克勒木等侵和闐，攻哈拉哈什，侍衛齊凌扎卜請援，兆惠令瑚爾起與巴圖濟爾噶勒督兵赴援。

translations.literal: Huojizhan's follower Abudukelimu and others invaded Khotan and attacked Karakash; Bodyguard Qilingzhabu requested aid, and Zhao Hui ordered Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to command troops to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Huojizhan's follower Abudukelimu and others invaded Khotan and assaulted Karakash; Bodyguard Qilingzhabu pleaded for reinforcements, and Zhao Hui ordered Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to lead troops to their relief.

sentences.zh: 齊凌扎卜馳告，夜行至伊立齊，賊聞兵至，引退。

translations.literal: Qilingzhabu reported in haste; they marched by night to Yiliqi, and when the rebels heard troops had come they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qilingzhabu sent urgent word; they marched through the night to Yiliqi, and at news of the approaching troops the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 诇知賊騎七百餘屯博爾齊，天大霧，瑚爾起督兵突擊，賊潰走，退至皁窪勒河，斬百餘級，收回人四千餘戶，和闐遂平。

translations.literal: Scouts reported more than seven hundred rebel cavalry camped at Bo'erqi; in thick fog Hu Erqi led a surprise attack, the rebels fled in rout to Zaowale River, more than a hundred were beheaded, more than four thousand households were recovered, and Khotan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported that more than seven hundred rebel horsemen were encamped at Bo'erqi; in dense fog Hu Erqi led a surprise assault, the rebels broke and fled to the Zaowale River, more than a hundred were killed, more than four thousand households were recovered, and Khotan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上賦博羅齊行紀事，賜瑚爾起雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a poem on the Bo'erqi campaign and bestowed on Hu Erqi a hereditary yunqiwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor composed a poem commemorating the Bo'erqi campaign and granted Hu Erqi a hereditary yunqiwei title.

sentences.zh: 師自喀喇烏蘇逐捕霍集占，至阿爾楚爾。

translations.literal: The army pursued Huojizhan from Kalasu to A'ertuer.
translations.idiomatic: The army pursued Huojizhan from Kalasu as far as A'ertuer.

sentences.zh: 賊設伏兩山間，我軍張兩翼擊之，賊敗走三十里，負山而屯。

translations.literal: The rebels set an ambush between two mountains; our army deployed both wings to attack, the rebels were defeated and fled thirty li, and took position with the mountain at their backs.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels laid an ambush between two mountains; our forces deployed on both wings and drove them back thirty li, where they made a stand with the mountain at their backs.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起等自山麓橫衝入陣，師夾擊，賊大敗，越山遁，師從之，至伊西洱庫爾淖爾。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi and others charged into the line from the foot of the mountain; the army attacked from both sides, the rebels were utterly defeated, fled over the mountains, and the army pursued to Lake Yixierku'er.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi and his men charged into the enemy line from the mountain's foot while the main force struck from both sides; the rebels were utterly routed, fled over the mountains, and the army pursued them to Lake Yixierku'er.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起等為伏東山，側擊，賊復大敗，霍集占竄入巴達克山。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi and others lay in ambush on the eastern mountain and struck from the flank; the rebels were again utterly defeated, and Huojizhan fled into Badakhshan.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi and his men lay in ambush on the eastern slope and struck from the flank; the rebels were routed again, and Huojizhan fled into Badakhshan.

sentences.zh: 巴達克山汗素勒坦沙獻霍集占首。

translations.literal: The Badakhshan khan Sultan Shah presented Huojizhan's head.
translations.idiomatic: The khan of Badakhshan, Sultan Shah, presented Huojizhan's head.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起將索倫兵還，賚銀幣，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi led the Solon troops back; he was rewarded with silver and coins, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Luminosity among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi led the Solon troops home; he was rewarded with silver and cash, and his portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Luminosity among the first fifty meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起疏言：「呼倫貝爾多水泉，可耕。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi memorialized: "Hulun Buir has many springs and can be farmed.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi memorialized: "Hulun Buir has abundant springs and land fit for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 請選塔里雅沁降回百戶往耕。

translations.literal: Please select a hundred households of surrendered Muslims from Taliyaxin to go and farm there."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a hundred households of surrendered Muslims from Taliyaxin be chosen to settle there and farm."

sentences.zh: 」上命瑚爾起以副都統為呼倫貝爾總管，董其事。

translations.literal: The Emperor appointed Hu Erqi, with the rank of deputy military governor, commander at Hulun Buir to oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor appointed Hu Erqi, in his capacity as deputy military governor, commander at Hulun Buir to supervise the undertaking.

sentences.zh: 移黑龍江副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Deputy Military Governor of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as deputy military governor of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 從征緬甸，收猛拱、猛養諸地。

translations.literal: He joined the Burma campaign and recovered Menggong, Mengyang, and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Burma campaign and recovered Menggong, Mengyang, and other territories.

sentences.zh: 卒於軍。

translations.literal: He died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 賜騎都尉，並前世職為一等輕車都尉，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Commandant of Cavalry; combined with his previous fief it made a First Class Commandant of Light Chariots, and he was enshrined at the Shrine of Loyal Merit.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the rank of Commandant of Cavalry; together with his earlier fief this made a First Class Commandant of Light Chariots, and he was enshrined in the Shrine of Loyal Merit.

sentences.zh: 愛隆阿，覺爾察氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ai Long'a, of the Joociya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Long'a, of the Joociya clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒侍衛累遷齊齊哈爾副都統。

translations.literal: From vanguard bodyguard he was promoted in succession to Deputy Military Governor at Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard bodyguard through successive promotions to deputy military governor at Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，授領隊大臣，赴巴里坤軍營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Qianlong he was appointed commanding officer and went to the Barkul camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of the Qianlong reign he was appointed commanding officer and proceeded to the Barkul army camp.

sentences.zh: 偕參贊大臣富德逐捕巴雅爾，至愛登蘇，遇阿布賚部眾突出，數與戰，卻之。

translations.literal: With Grand Councillor Fude he pursued Bayar to Aidengsu; they encountered a sudden thrust by Abulai's followers, fought several engagements, and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Grand Councillor Fude he pursued Bayar to Aidengsu, where Abulai's followers suddenly appeared; after several engagements they drove them back.

sentences.zh: 自巴爾楚克至濟爾哈朗置台站，逐賊沙喇博和什嶺，遇都爾伯特納木奇游牧，乞降，旋遁去，愛隆阿追及之，殺千餘人，納木奇遂納款。

translations.literal: From Barkul to Jierhalang they established courier stations and pursued bandits to Shalabohoshi Ridge; they met the Dorlod Namiqi pasturing his herds, who begged to surrender then fled; Ai Long'a overtook him, killed more than a thousand, and Namiqi then submitted.
translations.idiomatic: From Barkul to Jierhalang they set up courier stations and pursued rebels to Shalabohoshi Ridge; they came upon the Dorlod Namiqi with his herds, who begged to surrender but soon fled; Ai Long'a overtook him, killed more than a thousand men, and Namiqi then submitted.

sentences.zh: 師至察罕烏蘇，收厄魯特宰桑烏魯木游牧百餘戶。

translations.literal: When the army reached Chahan Wusu they received the pastoral encampments of more than a hundred households of the Olot zaisang Ulumu.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Chahan Wusu they took in the pastoral camps of more than a hundred households belonging to the Olot zaisang Ulumu.

sentences.zh: 師屯濟爾哈朗，命愛隆阿駐守濟爾哈朗、巴里坤適中地。

translations.literal: The army encamped at Jierhalang and ordered Ai Long'a to garrison the midway point between Jierhalang and Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: The army encamped at Jierhalang and ordered Ai Long'a to hold the midway post between Jierhalang and Barkul.

sentences.zh: 尋從靖逆將軍雅爾哈善討霍集占。

translations.literal: Soon he followed the Pacification General Ya'erhashan in the campaign against Huojizhan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Pacification General Ya'erhashan in the campaign against Huojizhan.

sentences.zh: 先是愛登甦之戰，侍衛奇徹布戰沒，至是愛隆阿上言：「前擒巴雅爾，奪還奇徹布屍，富德未及疏列。

translations.literal: Earlier at the battle of Aidengsu, Bodyguard Qichebu had been killed in action; now Ai Long'a memorialized: "When we earlier captured Bayar we recovered Qichebu's corpse, but Fude had not yet reported this in a memorial."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the battle of Aidengsu, Bodyguard Qichebu had been killed in action; now Ai Long'a memorialized: "When Bayar was captured earlier we recovered Qichebu's body, but Fude had not yet reported it in his memorial."

sentences.zh: 」定邊將軍兆惠疏言：「愛隆阿原報所無，事後追論，顯為爭功，請嚴議。

translations.literal: Frontier General Zhao Hui memorialized: "What Ai Long'a reported was not in his original dispatches; discussing it afterward plainly shows contention for merit — please investigate him severely."
translations.idiomatic: Frontier General Zhao Hui wrote: "This was not in Ai Long'a's original reports; raising it afterward plainly shows a bid for credit — I ask that he be investigated and punished."

sentences.zh: 」詔原之。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 師圍庫車，賊來援，愛隆阿等與戰於戈壁，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: When the army besieged Kucha, rebels came to relieve the city; Ai Long'a and others fought them on the Gobi and destroyed a great many.
translations.idiomatic: When the army besieged Kucha and rebel reinforcements arrived, Ai Long'a and his men fought them on the Gobi and destroyed a great many.

sentences.zh: 霍集占將五千人續至，愛隆阿等率吉林及索倫兵千騎逐賊至鄂根河側，與戰，迫賊入水，死者三千餘人。

translations.literal: Huojizhan came with five thousand men; Ai Long'a and others with a thousand Jilin and Solon cavalry pursued the rebels to the bank of the Egen River, fought them, and pressed them into the water — more than three thousand drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Huojizhan arrived with five thousand more men; Ai Long'a led a thousand Jilin and Solon horsemen in pursuit to the Egen River, fought them there, and drove them into the water, where more than three thousand perished.

sentences.zh: 拔其纛，驛致京師。

translations.literal: They captured their battle standard and sent it post-haste to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: They seized the enemy standard and sent it post-haste to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上為賦回纛行，獎其能戰。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed a poem on the return of the standard and praised their fighting ability.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor composed a poem on the return of the captured standard and praised their prowess in battle.

sentences.zh: 旋從將軍兆惠至葉爾羌，與霍集占部眾戰，當左翼。

translations.literal: Soon he followed General Zhao Hui to Yarkand and fought Huojizhan's forces on the left wing.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed General Zhao Hui to Yarkand, fought Huojizhan's forces, and held the left wing.

sentences.zh: 兆惠被困，靖逆將軍納穆札爾赴援，愛隆阿將兵截喀什噶爾賊援路。

translations.literal: When Zhao Hui was trapped, Pacification General Namuzha'er went to relieve him; Ai Long'a led troops to cut off the Kashgar rebel relief route.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Hui was besieged, Pacification General Namuzha'er marched to his relief while Ai Long'a led troops to block the Kashgar rebel line of reinforcement.

sentences.zh: 徼巡台站，至托罕塔罕，遇賊，剿殺百餘人。

translations.literal: Patrolling courier stations he reached Tuhantahan, encountered rebels, and destroyed more than a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: While patrolling the courier stations he reached Tuhantahan, encountered rebels, and killed more than a hundred.

sentences.zh: 上授愛隆阿參贊大臣，令與定邊右副將軍富德援兆惠。

translations.literal: The Emperor appointed Ai Long'a Grand Councillor and ordered him with Assistant Frontier General on the right Fude to relieve Zhao Hui.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor appointed Ai Long'a a grand councillor and ordered him, together with Assistant Frontier General Fude on the right, to relieve Zhao Hui.

sentences.zh: 愛隆阿戰呼爾璊，再戰葉爾羌河，遂與兆惠軍合。

translations.literal: Ai Long'a fought at Hur'eren and again at the Yarkand River, then joined Zhao Hui's army.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Long'a fought at Hur'eren and again on the Yarkand River, then united with Zhao Hui's army.

sentences.zh: 尋引兵駐烏什，兼防喀什噶爾，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Soon he led troops to garrison Ush, also defending Kashgar, and was granted a hereditary yunqiwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led his troops to garrison Ush while also guarding Kashgar, and was granted a hereditary yunqiwei title.

sentences.zh: 復從富德逐霍集占，戰於伊西洱庫爾淖爾。

translations.literal: He again followed Fude in pursuit of Huojizhan and fought at Lake Yixierku'er.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Fude in pursuit of Huojizhan and fought at Lake Yixierku'er.

sentences.zh: 徼巡台站，值嗎唬斯、賓巴等謀劫察罕烏蘇台站，以兵追襲，斬獲殆盡，進騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: While patrolling stations he found Mahus, Binba, and others plotting to raid the Chahan Wusu station; he pursued and attacked, killing and capturing nearly all, and was advanced to a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry fief.
translations.idiomatic: While patrolling the stations he discovered that Mahus, Binba, and others were plotting to raid the Chahan Wusu post; he pursued and attacked them, killing or capturing nearly all, and was advanced to a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry title.

sentences.zh: 師還，授正白旗護軍統領，兼鑲白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was appointed commander of the Guard of the Plain White Banner and concurrently Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was made commander of the Plain White Banner Guard and concurrently Mongol deputy military governor of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Luminosity among the first fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Luminosity among the first fifty meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 再進一等輕車都尉兼一云騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He was further advanced to First Class Commandant of Light Chariots with one additional hereditary yunqiwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: He was further advanced to First Class Commandant of Light Chariots with an additional hereditary yunqiwei title.

sentences.zh: 授伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Councillor at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand councillor at Ili.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 弟巴靈阿，自親軍校累遷二等侍衛，授察哈爾總管。

translations.literal: His younger brother Ba Ling'a, from company commander of the imperial guard was promoted in succession to Second Class Bodyguard and appointed Chakhar commander.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Ba Ling'a rose from company commander of the imperial guard through successive promotions to Second Class Bodyguard and was appointed Chakhar commander.

sentences.zh: 賜坤都爾巴圖魯名號，授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He was granted the honorific name Kundul Batulu and appointed commanding officer.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the honorific title Kundul Batulu and appointed a commanding officer.

sentences.zh: 在博羅齊搜捕厄魯特部眾，遇伏戰死，賜雲騎尉世職，圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: While searching out Olot bands at Bo'erqi he encountered an ambush and died in battle; he was granted a hereditary yunqiwei fief, his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Luminosity among the latter fifty meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: While hunting down Olot bands at Bo'erqi he fell into an ambush and died in battle; he was granted a hereditary yunqiwei title, and his portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Luminosity among the latter fifty meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 舒明，烏梁海濟勒莫特氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Shu Ming, of the Uriankhai Jelemot clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Ming, of the Uriankhai Jelemot clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自二等侍衛累遷都察院左副都御史、正黃旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: From Second Class Bodyguard he was promoted in succession to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief and commander of the Guard of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from Second Class Bodyguard through successive promotions to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief and commander of the Plain Yellow Banner Guard.

sentences.zh: 命赴北路軍，為諸部降人董理游牧。

translations.literal: He was ordered to the northern-route army to oversee the pastoral arrangements of surrenderees from various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to the northern-route army to supervise the pastoral settlement of surrenderees from the various tribes.

sentences.zh: 旋授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 诇知降人訥默庫戕台站侍衛，謀以所部叛，馳奏。

translations.literal: Scouts learned that the surrenderee Nemuku had killed a station bodyguard and plotted rebellion with his following; he reported urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Intelligence revealed that the surrenderee Nemuku had killed a courier-station bodyguard and was plotting to rebel with his following; he sent an urgent memorial.

sentences.zh: 敕參贊大臣阿蘭泰往捕治，阿蘭泰請益兵，上責其紛擾。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Grand Councillor Alantai to go capture and punish him; Alantai requested additional troops and the Emperor rebuked him for causing disorder.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Grand Councillor Alantai to go and capture him, but when Alantai asked for more troops the Emperor rebuked him for stirring up trouble.

sentences.zh: 訥默庫就擒，上以舒明籌策得宜，而阿蘭泰推諉遲誤，奪阿蘭泰三等男爵畀舒明。

translations.literal: Nemuku was captured; because Shu Ming's planning had been sound and Alantai had shifted blame and delayed, the Emperor stripped Alantai of his third-class marquisate and gave it to Shu Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Nemuku was captured; because Shu Ming's planning had been sound while Alantai had shifted blame and delayed, the Emperor stripped Alantai of his third-class marquisate and transferred it to Shu Ming.

sentences.zh: 舒明在邊，諸部降人至者，為之拊循。

translations.literal: While Shu Ming was on the frontier, surrenderees from various tribes who arrived were comforted and settled by him.
translations.idiomatic: While Shu Ming was on the frontier, he comforted and settled the surrenderees from the various tribes as they arrived.

sentences.zh: 噶勒雜特宰桑根敦降，上授佐領，使與丹畢游牧同處。

translations.literal: The Galzut zaisang Gendun surrendered; the Emperor appointed him an assistant commandant and had him pasture alongside Danbi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Galzut zaisang Gendun surrendered, the Emperor made him an assistant commandant and had his people pasture alongside Danbi's.

sentences.zh: 都爾伯特台吉伯什阿噶什、烏巴什降，上授伯什阿噶什親王、烏巴什貝子，游牧額爾齊斯，舒明為陳請留屯哈達青吉勒。

translations.literal: The Dorlod taiji Bishi'agashi and Ubashi surrendered; the Emperor made Bishi'agashi a prince and Ubashi a beile, pasturing on the Irtysh; Shu Ming memorialized asking that they remain encamped at Hadaqingjile.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dorlod taiji Bishi'agashi and Ubashi surrendered, the Emperor made Bishi'agashi a prince and Ubashi a beile and assigned them to pasture on the Irtysh; Shu Ming memorialized asking that they be allowed to remain encamped at Hadaqingjile.

sentences.zh: 達什達瓦部降，編為三旗，移阿爾台；

translations.literal: When Doshidawa's following surrendered they were organized into three banners and moved to the Altai;
translations.idiomatic: When Doshidawa's following surrendered, they were organized into three banners and moved to the Altai;

sentences.zh: 其續至者，使處扎哈沁舊游牧地。

translations.literal: those who continued to arrive were settled on the old Zahachin pastures.
translations.idiomatic: those who continued to arrive were settled on the former Zahachin pastures.

sentences.zh: 策淩烏巴什、巴圖博羅特及達瑪林等部眾貧甚，疏請賑，上為發米六百石。

translations.literal: The followers of Tsewang Ubashi, Batuborot, and Damalin were exceedingly poor; in a memorial he requested relief, and the Emperor sent six hundred shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The followers of Tsewang Ubashi, Batuborot, and Damalin were desperately poor; he memorialized for relief, and the Emperor sent six hundred shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 上聞和托輝特青滾雜卜將叛，命舒明诇之。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard that the Khalkha Qinggunzhab of the Khotogut would rebel and ordered Shu Ming to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard that Qinggunzhab of the Khotogut was about to rebel, he ordered Shu Ming to investigate.

sentences.zh: 舒明言叛已著，命會將軍成袞札布等捕治。

translations.literal: Shu Ming reported that rebellion was already evident and was ordered to join Generals Cheng'gunzhab and others in capturing and punishing them.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Ming reported that the rebellion was already manifest, and he was ordered to join Generals Cheng'gunzhab and others in capturing and punishing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 授參贊大臣，成袞札布令將科布多兵二百以往。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Councillor; Cheng'gunzhab ordered two hundred troops from Kobdo to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a grand councillor; Cheng'gunzhab ordered two hundred Kobdo troops to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 上命侍衛巴寧阿勒泰將三百人為舒明佐。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Bodyguard Baning'a of Altai to lead three hundred men as Shu Ming's assistants.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Bodyguard Baning'a of Altai to lead three hundred men to assist Shu Ming.

sentences.zh: 旋命偕成袞札布駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to garrison Uliassutai with Cheng'gunzhab.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to garrison Uliassutai together with Cheng'gunzhab.

sentences.zh: 授理籓部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 再遷綏遠城將軍，兼領歸化城都統。

translations.literal: He was further promoted to General of Suiyuan and concurrently commander at Guisihua.
translations.idiomatic: He was further promoted to general of Suiyuan and concurrently commander at Guisihua.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-seventh year.

sentences.zh: 子雅滿泰，襲三等男。

translations.literal: His son Yamantai inherited the third-class marquisate.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yamantai inherited the third-class marquisate.

sentences.zh: 累遷正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to Mongol deputy military governor of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 坐事左授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted to First Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he was demoted to First Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 與保泰同充駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: Together with Baotai he was appointed Resident Minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: He and Baotai were jointly appointed resident ministers in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀侵後藏，與保泰同得罪，荷校被杖。

translations.literal: When Gurkha invaded Rear Tibet he and Baotai were alike found guilty, placed in the cangue and flogged.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gurkhas invaded Rear Tibet he and Baotai were both found guilty, placed in the cangue, and flogged.

sentences.zh: 復起至頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: He was later restored to First Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was later restored to First Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 福祿，旺察氏，蒙古正白旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Lu, of the Wangca clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lu, of the Wangca clan, was a Mongol bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自護軍校累遷福建建寧鎮總兵。

translations.literal: From guard soldier he was promoted in succession to Commander of Jianning Garrison in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from guard soldier through successive promotions to commander of the Jianning garrison in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 內移正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred within the banners to Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred within the banners to Mongol deputy military governor of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 外授直隸宣化、廣東右翼諸鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was posted outside as Commander at Xuanhua in Zhili and Commander of the Right Wing in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted outside the banners as commander at Xuanhua in Zhili and commander of the right wing in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 又內移正紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: He was again transferred within to Hanjun Deputy Military Governor of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred within the banners to Hanjun deputy military governor of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年，授參贊大臣，駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong he was appointed Grand Councillor and garrisoned at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of the Qianlong reign he was appointed a grand councillor and garrisoned at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 旋命將索倫兵二千人赴巴里坤。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to lead two thousand Solon troops to Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to lead two thousand Solon troops to Barkul.

sentences.zh: 時定邊左副將軍成袞札布與參贊大臣阿桂會討舍楞，福祿請具三月糧，自科布多輸送，從之。

translations.literal: At that time Assistant Frontier General on the left Cheng'gunzhab and Grand Councillor Agui were jointly campaigning against Sheleng; Fu Lu asked to prepare three months' grain to be transported from Kobdo, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Assistant Frontier General Cheng'gunzhab on the left and Grand Councillor Agui were jointly campaigning against Sheleng; Fu Lu requested three months' provisions to be shipped from Kobdo, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 至海拉爾，與御前侍衛敦察會師進。

translations.literal: Reaching Hailar, he joined forces with Imperial Bodyguard Duncha and advanced.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Hailar he united with Imperial Bodyguard Duncha and marched forward.

sentences.zh: 旋佐將軍兆惠討霍集占，偕定邊右副將軍富德帥師次呼爾璊。

translations.literal: Soon he assisted General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan, and with Assistant Frontier General on the right Fude commanded the army stationed at Hur'eren.
translations.idiomatic: He soon assisted General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan and, together with Assistant Frontier General Fude on the right, commanded the army encamped at Hur'eren.

sentences.zh: 霍集占以五千餘人來犯，福祿偕領隊大臣永慶率索倫、察哈爾兵擊之，自巳至申，與賊戰十餘次，賊潰去。

translations.literal: Huojizhan came with more than five thousand men to attack; Fu Lu with Commanding Officer Yongqing led Solon and Chakhar troops against them; from the si hour to the shen hour they fought more than ten engagements and the rebels dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Huojizhan attacked with more than five thousand men; Fu Lu and Commanding Officer Yongqing led Solon and Chakhar troops against them and, from mid-morning to late afternoon, fought more than ten engagements until the rebels broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 進次葉爾羌河岸，城賊突圍出，富德與福祿等領中軍自右進，追賊渡河，賊屢敗。

translations.literal: Advancing to the bank of the Yarkand River, the city's rebels broke out; Fude with Fu Lu and others led the center army from the right, pursued the rebels across the river, and the rebels were repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to the Yarkand River, they found the city's rebels breaking out; Fude and Fu Lu led the center column from the right, pursued them across the river, and defeated them again and again.

sentences.zh: 兆惠自葉爾羌出，至阿爾吉什，偵鄂斯璊方侵和闐，疏請富德、福祿帥師策應。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui came out from Yarkand to A'erjishi; scouts reported Esilan was invading Khotan; he memorialized asking Fude and Fu Lu to lead troops in support.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui marched out from Yarkand to A'erjishi; intelligence reported that Esilan was invading Khotan, and he memorialized asking Fude and Fu Lu to lead troops in support.

sentences.zh: 上命福祿偕策布登札布以兵堵霍集占竄俄羅斯路。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Fu Lu with Cebudengzhabu to block Huojizhan's route of flight into Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Fu Lu, together with Cebudengzhabu, to block Huojizhan's escape route toward Russia.

sentences.zh: 旋命駐軍和闐，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered to garrison at Khotan and granted a hereditary yunqiwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to garrison Khotan and was granted a hereditary yunqiwei title.

sentences.zh: 遷杭州將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be General at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as general at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾平，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When Dzungaria was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Luminosity.
translations.idiomatic: After Dzungaria was pacified, his portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Luminosity.

sentences.zh: 上巡浙江，福祿督駐防兵肄武，制閱武詩獎之。

translations.literal: When the Emperor toured Zhejiang, Fu Lu supervised the garrison troops in military drill; the Emperor composed a poem on the military review to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: During the imperial tour of Zhejiang, Fu Lu drilled the garrison troops; the Emperor composed a poem commemorating the military review to reward him.

sentences.zh: 調西安將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be General at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as general at Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed grand minister of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 以老乞休。

translations.literal: He begged to retire on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: He requested retirement on grounds of age.

sentences.zh: 卒 齊里克齊，蒙古鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: He died. Qi Likeqi was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Qi Likeqi was a Mongol bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 初為額魯特人，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Originally he was an Olot, taking his place-name as clan name.
translations.idiomatic: Originally an Olot, he took his homeland as his clan name.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，師徵準噶爾，來降。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned against Dzungaria, he came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of the Qianlong reign, when the army campaigned against Dzungaria, he came over and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾平，從定邊將軍兆惠擊霍集占，戰於霍爾果斯。

translations.literal: When Dzungaria was pacified he followed Frontier General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan and fought at Khorgos.
translations.idiomatic: After Dzungaria was pacified he followed Frontier General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan and fought at Khorgos.

sentences.zh: 霍集占敗走，降頭人圖魯啟拜等，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Huojizhan was defeated and fled; he received the surrender of leaders Turuqibai and others and was appointed a Blue Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Huojizhan was defeated and fled, he received the submission of leaders such as Turuqibai and was appointed a Blue Plume Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 護哈薩克使臣詣京師，遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: He escorted Kazakh envoys to the capital and was promoted to Third Class Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He escorted Kazakh envoys to the capital and was promoted to Third Class Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 復從定邊右副將軍富德擊霍集占，至色勒庫爾，敵踞山以拒。

translations.literal: He again followed Assistant Frontier General on the right Fude against Huojizhan to Sileku'er, where the enemy held the mountains to resist.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Assistant Frontier General Fude on the right against Huojizhan as far as Sileku'er, where the enemy held the heights and resisted.

sentences.zh: 齊里克齊偕前鋒參領喀木齊布督健銳營兵自山陰攀登仰擊，霍集占敗遁。

translations.literal: Qi Likeqi with Vanguard Colonel Kamuqibu commanded Elite Vanguard troops to climb from the shady side of the mountain and strike upward; Huojizhan was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Likeqi and Vanguard Colonel Kamuqibu led Elite Vanguard troops up the shaded slope of the mountain in a climbing assault; Huojizhan was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 降所部二千餘人，獲軍器、駝騾，賜布哈巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: More than two thousand of his following surrendered; military equipment and camels were captured; he was granted the brave name Buhā Batulu.
translations.idiomatic: More than two thousand of the enemy following surrendered; arms and camels were captured, and he was granted the brave name Buhā Batulu.

sentences.zh: 師還，命在乾清門行走，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was ordered to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Luminosity.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was ordered to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, and his portrait was enshrined in the Hall of Purple Luminosity.

sentences.zh: 再遷頭等侍衛，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He was further promoted to First Class Bodyguard and granted a hereditary yunqiwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: He was further promoted to First Class Bodyguard and granted a hereditary yunqiwei title.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，從將軍明瑞徵緬甸，遇賊於底麻，敗之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he followed General Mingrui against Burma; at Dima he encountered rebels and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he followed General Mingrui against Burma, encountered rebels at Dima, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賜副都統銜。

translations.literal: He was granted the rank of deputy military governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the rank of deputy military governor.

sentences.zh: 召回京，再遷鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Recalled to the capital, he was again promoted to Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to the capital, he was again promoted to Mongol deputy military governor of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，師徵金川，命督健銳營從參贊大臣阿桂出南路。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, when the army campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to command the Elite Vanguard in following Grand Councillor Agui on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year, when the army campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to command the Elite Vanguard and follow Grand Councillor Agui on the southern route.

sentences.zh: 授領隊大臣，攻美諾，克之。

translations.literal: Appointed commanding officer, he attacked Meinuo and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed a commanding officer, he attacked Meinuo and took it.

sentences.zh: 金川平，師還，領健銳營。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified and the army returned, he commanded the Elite Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Jinchuan was pacified and the army returned, he took command of the Elite Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，教匪起，送察哈爾馬如湖北軍，事竟即還。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign when the sectarian rebels rose, he sent Chakhar horses to Hubei for the army; when the affair was settled he returned immediately.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign, when the sectarian rebels rose, he sent Chakhar horses to the Hubei army and returned as soon as the affair was settled.

sentences.zh: 上以未請從軍，詔詰責，奪官，削世職。

translations.literal: Because he had not asked to join the campaign, an edict reprimanded him, stripped him of office, and revoked his hereditary fief.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had not asked to join the campaign, an edict rebuked him, stripped him of office, and revoked his hereditary title.

sentences.zh: 尋授鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Mongol deputy military governor of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 閻相師，字渭陽，陝西高台人。

translations.literal: Yan Xiangshi, style Weiyang, was a native of Gaotai in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xiangshi, whose style was Weiyang, was a native of Gaotai in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 入伍。

translations.literal: He entered military service.
translations.idiomatic: He entered military service.

sentences.zh: 累遷安西前營游擊。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Colonel of the Anxi Front Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to colonel of the Anxi Front Camp.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善謀誅厄魯特降人沙克都爾曼吉。

translations.literal: Ya'erhashan planned to execute the surrendered Olot Shakudurmanji.
translations.idiomatic: Ya'erhashan planned to execute the surrendered Olot Shakudurmanji.

sentences.zh: 天大雪，相師將五百人，偽為失道，求寄宿其壘。

translations.literal: In heavy snow Xiangshi led five hundred men, pretending to have lost their way, and begged lodging at his camp.
translations.idiomatic: In a heavy snowfall Xiangshi led five hundred men, pretended they had lost their way, and asked to lodge in Shakudurmanji's camp.

sentences.zh: 夜分，鳴笳驟起，殺沙克都爾曼吉，殲其部眾四千餘人。

translations.literal: At midnight they sounded horns and rose suddenly, killed Shakudurmanji, and annihilated more than four thousand of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight they sounded horns and rose suddenly, killed Shakudurmanji, and wiped out more than four thousand of his followers.

sentences.zh: 尋偕副將醜達將千人赴魯克察克同額敏和卓逐回酋莽阿里克。

translations.literal: Soon he with Deputy General Chouda led a thousand men to Lukechake together with Emin Hezhuo to drive out the Muslim chief Mang'alike.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he and Deputy General Chouda led a thousand men to Lukechake, where together with Emin Hezhuo they drove out the Muslim chief Mang'alike.

sentences.zh: 錄功，遷金塔寺營副將。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded; he was promoted to Deputy General of Jinta Temple Camp.
translations.idiomatic: His merit was recorded, and he was promoted to deputy general of the Jinta Temple Camp.

sentences.zh: 屯田吐魯番。

translations.literal: He farmed the land at Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: He organized farming at Turfan.

sentences.zh: 擢甘肅肅州鎮總兵，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Commander of Suzhou Garrison in Gansu and granted a peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commander of the Suzhou garrison in Gansu and granted a peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 從雅爾哈善討霍集占，授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He followed Ya'erhashan against Huojizhan and was appointed commanding officer.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Ya'erhashan against Huojizhan and was appointed a commanding officer.

sentences.zh: 圍庫車，力戰被創。

translations.literal: At the siege of Kucha he fought fiercely and was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: At the siege of Kucha he fought fiercely and was wounded.

sentences.zh: 師克阿克蘇，以相師駐守。

translations.literal: When the army captured Aksu, Xiangshi was left to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: When the army captured Aksu, Xiangshi was left to garrison the city.

sentences.zh: 已，复隨剿霍集占於葉爾羌。

translations.literal: Later he again followed in pursuit of Huojizhan at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again joined the pursuit of Huojizhan at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 授安西提督，駐喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: He was appointed Military Governor of Anxi, garrisoned at Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military governor of Anxi and garrisoned at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改甘肅提督，移駐庫車。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to Military Governor of Gansu and moved his garrison to Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was reassigned as military governor of Gansu and moved his headquarters to Kucha.

sentences.zh: 上命屯田烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered him to farm the land at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered him to organize farming at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，入覲，賚銀幣，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: On triumphant return he had audience; he was rewarded with silver and coins and his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Luminosity.
translations.idiomatic: On his triumphant return he had audience with the Emperor, was rewarded with silver and cash, and had his portrait enshrined in the Hall of Purple Luminosity.

sentences.zh: 引疾罷，予食全俸。

translations.literal: He cited illness and resigned; he was granted full salary.
translations.idiomatic: He cited illness and resigned; he was granted his full salary.

sentences.zh: 旋卒，贈太子太保，諡桓肅。

translations.literal: Soon he died; posthumously he was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Huansu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was posthumously made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Huansu.

sentences.zh: 相師軀幹修偉，有至性。

translations.literal: Xiangshi was tall in stature and of deep filial feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangshi was tall and powerfully built, and possessed a deeply filial nature.

sentences.zh: 既貴，念親不逮養，每食泣下。

translations.literal: After he rose to eminence, remembering that he could no longer care for his parents, he wept at every meal.
translations.idiomatic: After he had risen to eminence, remembering that he could no longer care for his parents in life, he wept at every meal.

sentences.zh: 得俸與兄弟，不問出入。

translations.literal: He gave his salary to his brothers without asking about income or outgo.
translations.idiomatic: He shared his salary with his brothers without keeping account of what came in or went out.

sentences.zh: 所居鎮夷堡地萬畝，為濬渠灌溉，數百家利賴之。

translations.literal: At Zhenyi Stockade where he lived, ten thousand mu of land was irrigated by canals he dug, benefiting several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhenyi Stockade, where he lived, he dug irrigation canals for ten thousand mu of land, to the benefit of several hundred households.

sentences.zh: 伊柱，薩克達氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Yi Zhu, of the Sakda clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhu, of the Sakda clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父塔勒馬善，雍正間，以副都統將歸化城兵從征噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: His father Tale'mashan, in the Yongzheng reign, as deputy military governor led Guisihua troops against Galdan Tsering.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tale'mashan, during the Yongzheng reign, served as deputy military governor and led Guisihua troops against Galdan Tsering.

sentences.zh: 將軍達爾濟駐伯格爾，世宗命塔勒馬善參贊軍務。

translations.literal: General Da'erji was stationed at Boge'er; the Shizong ordered Tale'mashan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: General Da'erji was stationed at Boge'er, and the Yongzheng Emperor ordered Tale'mashan to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 署前鋒統領，逐賊至額得爾河源，駐軍烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Acting as vanguard commander, he pursued bandits to the headwaters of the E'de'er River and garrisoned at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as acting vanguard commander, he pursued bandits to the headwaters of the E'de'er River and garrisoned the army at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，權定邊左副將軍，召還。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong he held acting Assistant Frontier General on the left and was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign he served as acting assistant frontier general on the left and was then recalled.

sentences.zh: 師复徵準噶爾，命赴額爾齊斯屯田。

translations.literal: When the army again campaigned against Dzungaria he was ordered to go farm the land on the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: When the army again campaigned against Dzungaria he was ordered to organize farming on the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Grand Councillor on the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was appointed grand councillor on the northern route.

sentences.zh: 復召還，授護軍統領。

translations.literal: He was again recalled and appointed commander of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled again and appointed commander of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 伊柱，自佐領再遷索倫總管。

translations.literal: Yi Zhu, from assistant commandant was again promoted to Solon commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhu rose from assistant commandant to Solon commander.

sentences.zh: 偕副都統濟福、侍衛德爾森保赴喀爾喀車臣部捕盜，得逋賊。

translations.literal: With Deputy Military Governor Jifu and Bodyguard De'ersenbao he went to the Khalkha Chakhar department to capture bandits and obtained fugitive criminals.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Deputy Military Governor Jifu and Bodyguard De'ersenbao he went to the Khalkha Chakhar department to capture bandits and seized the fugitives.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從將軍兆惠討霍集占。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he followed General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he followed General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan.

sentences.zh: 霍集占之棄葉爾羌走也，副將軍富德等逐之，至阿爾楚爾。

translations.literal: When Huojizhan abandoned Yarkand and fled, Assistant General Fude and others pursued to A'ertuer.
translations.idiomatic: When Huojizhan abandoned Yarkand and fled, Assistant General Fude and others pursued him as far as A'ertuer.

sentences.zh: 賊設伏兩山間，師分三隊奮擊，伊柱領右翼，戰自辰至午，賊大潰。

translations.literal: The rebels set an ambush between two mountains; the army divided into three columns and struck fiercely; Yi Zhu led the right wing and fought from the chen hour to the wu hour; the rebels were utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels laid an ambush between two mountains; the army divided into three columns and attacked fiercely; Yi Zhu led the right wing and fought from morning until noon, utterly routing the rebels.

sentences.zh: 翌日，至巴達克山界伊西洱庫爾淖爾，賊據險守。

translations.literal: The next day they reached the Badakhshan border at Lake Yixierku'er, where the rebels held the heights in defense.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they reached the Badakhshan border at Lake Yixierku'er, where the rebels held the defiles and defended them.

sentences.zh: 師分道進攻，樹白纛，降賊萬餘。

translations.literal: The army attacked along divided routes, raised white standards, and more than ten thousand rebels surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The army attacked along separate routes, raised white standards of surrender, and more than ten thousand rebels submitted.

sentences.zh: 伊柱偕巴圖濟爾噶勒等堵山後策應。

translations.literal: Yi Zhu with Batujiergale and others blocked the rear of the mountains in support.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhu, together with Batujiergale and others, blocked the rear of the mountains to support the main attack.

sentences.zh: 富德遣侍衛賽音圖等諭巴達克山汗，使擒霍集占以獻。

translations.literal: Fude sent Bodyguard Saiyintu and others to instruct the khan of Badakhshan to seize Huojizhan and deliver him.
translations.idiomatic: Fude sent Bodyguard Saiyintu and others to instruct the khan of Badakhshan to seize Huojizhan and hand him over.

sentences.zh: 伊柱駐兵卡倫為聲援。

translations.literal: Yi Zhu garrisoned troops at the frontier post as backing force.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhu garrisoned troops at the frontier post to lend backing force.

sentences.zh: 瓦罕伯克率所部降。

translations.literal: The beg of Wakhan led his following to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The beg of Wakhan led his following in surrender.

sentences.zh: 尋，巴達克山汗素勒坦沙函獻霍集占首。

translations.literal: Soon the khan of Badakhshan Sultan Shah sent a letter presenting Huojizhan's head.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the khan of Badakhshan, Sultan Shah, sent a letter presenting Huojizhan's head.

sentences.zh: 回部平。

translations.literal: The Muslim territories were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Muslim territories were pacified.

sentences.zh: 伊柱將千人駐喀什噶爾，護諸降人屯田伊犁。

translations.literal: Yi Zhu with a thousand men garrisoned Kashgar, protecting the various surrenderees farming at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhu led a thousand men to garrison Kashgar and protect the various surrenderees who were farming at Ili.

sentences.zh: 師還，上御豐澤園宴勞，賜伊柱緞十二、白金五百。

translations.literal: When the army returned the Emperor feasted the troops at Fengzeyuan and rewarded Yi Zhu with twelve bolts of satin and five hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, the Emperor feasted the troops at Fengzeyuan and rewarded Yi Zhu with twelve bolts of satin and five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 伊柱復出領屯田，為置台守望，疏渠灌溉，農隙督佃伐木作屋以居，上諭令加意開拓。

translations.literal: Yi Zhu again went out to lead farming, set up courier posts and watch stations, dredged canals for irrigation, and in intervals between farming seasons supervised tenants in felling timber to build houses; the Emperor ordered him to develop the land with special care.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Zhu again went out to lead the farming colonies, established courier posts and watch stations, dredged irrigation canals, and in the intervals between farming seasons supervised tenants in felling timber to build dwellings; the Emperor ordered him to develop the land with special diligence.

sentences.zh: 遷鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Mongol deputy military governor of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 從將軍明瑞徵緬甸，擊賊老官屯。

translations.literal: He followed General Mingrui against Burma and attacked rebels at Laoguandun.
translations.idiomatic: He followed General Mingrui against Burma and attacked the rebels at Laoguandun.

sentences.zh: 卒於軍，進三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: He died in the army and was posthumously advanced to Third Class Commandant of Light Chariots hereditary fief.
translations.idiomatic: He died on campaign and was posthumously advanced to a hereditary Third Class Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 努三，瓜爾佳氏，吉林滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Nu San, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Jilin Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Nu San, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Jilin Manchu bannerman of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒再遷頭等侍衛、御前行走。

translations.literal: From vanguard he was again promoted to First Class Bodyguard and served before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard to First Class Bodyguard and served in attendance before the throne.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，四川總督慶復剿下瞻對頭人班滾，命努三如慶復軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Qianlong, when Sichuan Governor Qingfu campaigned against the lower Zhandui chief Banbeng, Nu San was ordered to Qingfu's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign, when Sichuan Governor Qingfu campaigned against the lower Zhandui chief Banbeng, Nu San was ordered to join Qingfu's army.

sentences.zh: 慶復疏報班滾焚死，罷兵。

translations.literal: Qingfu memorialized that Banbeng had burned himself to death and the army was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Qingfu memorialized that Banbeng had burned himself to death, and the army was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 張廣泗代慶復，言班滾現在。

translations.literal: Zhang Guangsi replaced Qingfu and reported that Banbeng was still alive.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi replaced Qingfu and reported that Banbeng was still alive.

sentences.zh: 慶復坐得罪，努三罷御前行走。

translations.literal: Qingfu was found guilty; Nu San was dismissed from serving before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Qingfu was found guilty, and Nu San was dismissed from attendance before the throne.

sentences.zh: 尋授鑲白旗蒙古副都統、正藍旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Bordered White Banner and commander of the Plain Blue Banner Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Mongol deputy military governor of the Bordered White Banner and commander of the Plain Blue Banner Guard.

sentences.zh: 十八年，師徵準噶爾，命從湖廣總督永常籌軍事。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against Dzungaria, he was ordered to follow Huguang Governor Yongchang in planning military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against Dzungaria, he was ordered to assist Huguang Governor Yongchang in planning military affairs.

sentences.zh: 旋帥師駐鄂爾坤。

translations.literal: Soon he commanded troops garrisoned at Orkhon.
translations.idiomatic: He soon commanded troops garrisoned at Orkhon.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾宰桑瑪木特闌入卡倫。

translations.literal: The Dzungar zaisang Mamute crossed the frontier post.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungar zaisang Mamute crossed the frontier post.

sentences.zh: 授參贊大臣，命會將軍成袞札布逐捕。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Councillor and ordered to join General Cheng'gunzhab in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a grand councillor and ordered to join General Cheng'gunzhab in the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 努三與參贊大臣薩賴爾、護軍統領烏勒登合軍，軍不戢，雜取牲畜。

translations.literal: Nu San united with Grand Councillor Salai'er and Guard Commander Wu Leideng; the army was undisciplined and indiscriminately seized livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Nu San united his forces with Grand Councillor Salai'er and Guard Commander Wu Leideng, but the army was undisciplined and indiscriminately seized livestock.

sentences.zh: 努三獲逃人特赫拜哈都，未聞上。

translations.literal: Nu San captured the fugitive Tehebai Hadu but did not report it to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Nu San captured the fugitive Tehebai Hadu but failed to report it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 烏勒登收烏梁海，縱逃人巴朗。

translations.literal: Wu Leideng received the Uriankhai but let the fugitive Balang escape.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Leideng took in the Uriankhai but allowed the fugitive Balang to escape.

sentences.zh: 上詰責努三、烏勒登，下定北將軍班第等按治。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked Nu San and Wu Leideng and ordered Pacification General on the North Bandi and others to investigate and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked Nu San and Wu Leideng and ordered Pacification General Bandi on the northern frontier and others to investigate and punish them.

sentences.zh: 努三、烏勒登自陳收牲畜匿以自私事始薩賴爾，上以薩賴爾新降，不知法度，責努三等不得以此諉過。

translations.literal: Nu San and Wu Leideng themselves confessed that concealing seized livestock for private gain began with Salai'er; the Emperor said Salai'er had newly surrendered and did not know the law, and rebuked Nu San and the others for not being able to shift blame thus.
translations.idiomatic: Nu San and Wu Leideng confessed that the practice of seizing livestock and concealing them for private gain had begun with Salai'er; the Emperor said Salai'er had only recently surrendered and did not know the regulations, and rebuked Nu San and his colleagues for trying to shift the blame.

sentences.zh: 尋讞上，坐失巴朗，罪當斬。

translations.literal: Soon the verdict was submitted; for losing Balang the crime was death by execution.
translations.idiomatic: When the verdict was submitted, the charge of letting Balang escape carried the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 詔錄其前勞，恕死，留軍，仍籍其家。

translations.literal: An edict recorded their former merit, pardoned death, kept them in the army, but still registered their households for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict took note of their earlier service, spared their lives, kept them with the army, but still registered their households for punishment.

sentences.zh: 旋授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed a Blue Plume Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 再遷頭等侍衛，命與左都御史何國宗赴伊犁，測天度，繪地圖。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to First Class Bodyguard and ordered with Left Censor-in-Chief He Guozong to go to Ili to measure celestial degrees and draw maps.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to First Class Bodyguard and ordered, together with Left Censor-in-Chief He Guozong, to go to Ili to measure celestial degrees and draw maps.

sentences.zh: 送兵詣巴里坤，請回京。

translations.literal: He escorted troops to Barkul and requested return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He escorted troops to Barkul and asked to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 左授藍翎侍衛，留巴里坤差遣。

translations.literal: He was demoted to Blue Plume Bodyguard and left at Barkul for assignments.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to Blue Plume Bodyguard and left at Barkul on special assignment.

sentences.zh: 招撫巴爾達穆特各鄂拓克有勞，三遷鑲藍旗護軍統領，督巴里坤屯田。

translations.literal: For merit in winning over the various otoks of Baldamut, he was thrice promoted to commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Guard and supervised farming at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: For his success in winning over the various otoks of Baldamut, he was promoted three times to commander of the Bordered Blue Banner Guard and put in charge of farming at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 兆惠被圍黑水，努三從定邊左副將軍富德往援，至呼爾璊，分兩翼擊賊，與兆惠軍會，賜騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Zhao Hui was besieged at Black Water, Nu San followed Assistant Frontier General on the left Fude to the relief; reaching Hur'eren they attacked the rebels on both wings, joined Zhao Hui's army, and he was granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry fief.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Hui was besieged at Black Water, Nu San followed Assistant Frontier General Fude on the left to his relief; at Hur'eren they attacked the rebels on both wings, united with Zhao Hui's army, and Nu San was granted a hereditary Commandant of Cavalry title.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜銀幣。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was rewarded with silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was rewarded with silver and cash.

sentences.zh: 累遷領侍衛內大臣、正藍旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard and Manchu Commander of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to grand minister of the Imperial Guard and Manchu commander of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恪靖。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous title Kejing.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous title Kejing.

sentences.zh: 烏勒登，烏禮蘇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Wu Leideng, of the Wulisu clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Leideng, of the Wulisu clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒累遷鑲黃旗蒙古副都統、護軍統​​領。

translations.literal: From vanguard he was promoted in succession to Mongol Deputy Military Governor of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard through successive promotions to Mongol deputy military governor of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the Guard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，從征金川。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he joined the Jinchuan campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Qianlong reign he took part in the Jinchuan campaign.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士傅恆至軍，令駐軍馬奈。

translations.literal: When Grand Secretary Fu Heng arrived at the army he ordered him to garrison at Manai.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Secretary Fu Heng arrived at the army, he ordered Wu Leideng to garrison at Manai.

sentences.zh: 十八年，師徵準噶爾，授參贊大臣，駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against Dzungaria, he was appointed Grand Councillor and garrisoned at Uliassutai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against Dzungaria, he was appointed a grand councillor and garrisoned at Uliassutai.

sentences.zh: 扎哈沁宰桑瑪木特等闌入卡倫，烏勒登偕喀爾喀副都統策登扎卜將五百人，與參贊大臣努三分道捕治。

translations.literal: The Zahachin zaisang Mamute and others crossed the frontier post; Wu Leideng with Khalkha Deputy Military Governor Cedengzhabu led five hundred men and with Grand Councillor Nu San pursued along separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zahachin zaisang Mamute and others crossed the frontier post, Wu Leideng and Khalkha Deputy Military Governor Cedengzhabu led five hundred men and, together with Grand Councillor Nu San, pursued them along separate routes.

sentences.zh: 參贊大臣薩賴爾收烏梁海，烏勒登自索郭克策應，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor Salai'er received the Uriankhai; Wu Leideng supported from Suoguo'ke and captured a great many.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Salai'er took in the Uriankhai; Wu Leideng supported the operation from Suoguo'ke and captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 尋坐縱逃人巴朗，並與努三匿所獲烏梁海牲畜，罪當斬，貸死從軍。

translations.literal: Soon for letting the fugitive Balang escape and together with Nu San concealing Uriankhai livestock seized, the crime was death by execution; death was commuted and he followed the army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was charged with letting the fugitive Balang escape and, together with Nu San, concealing Uriankhai livestock that had been seized; the penalty was death, but his life was spared and he remained with the army.

sentences.zh: 尋授頭等侍衛，命選厄魯特宰桑厄勒錐音等兵赴伊犁討賊。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed First Class Bodyguard and ordered to select Olot zaisang Elezhuiyin and other troops to go to Ili against bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed First Class Bodyguard and ordered to select troops under the Olot zaisang Elezhuiyin and others and march to Ili against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 加副都統銜，授領隊大臣，進剿阿巴噶斯、哈丹等游牧。

translations.literal: He was given the rank of deputy military governor and appointed commanding officer, advancing to suppress the pastoral encampments of Abagasi, Hadan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the rank of deputy military governor, appointed a commanding officer, and advanced to suppress the pastoral camps of Abagasi, Hadan, and others.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納竄哈薩克，定西將軍策楞遣烏勒登將千人從參贊大臣玉保逐捕，玉保中道引還。

translations.literal: Amursana fled into Kazakh lands; Pacification General on the West Celeng sent Wu Leideng with a thousand men to follow Grand Councillor Yubao in pursuit; Yubao turned back midway.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana fled into Kazakh lands, Pacification General Celeng on the western frontier sent Wu Leideng with a thousand men to follow Grand Councillor Yubao in pursuit, but Yubao turned back midway.

sentences.zh: 烏勒登師至庫隴癸嶺，阿睦爾撒納脫走。

translations.literal: When Wu Leideng's army reached Kulonggui Ridge, Amursana escaped.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Wu Leideng's army reached Kulonggui Ridge, Amursana had already slipped away.

sentences.zh: 逮詣京師，廷鞫，言：「初聞阿睦爾撒納遁，請發兵速追之。

translations.literal: Brought to the capital and tried at court, he said: "When I first heard Amursana had fled, I requested troops be sent to pursue swiftly.
translations.idiomatic: Brought to the capital and tried at court, he said: "When I first heard that Amursana had fled, I asked that troops be sent out at once to pursue him.

sentences.zh: 策楞、玉保俱不允。

translations.literal: Celeng and Yubao both refused.
translations.idiomatic: Both Celeng and Yubao refused.

sentences.zh: 後從玉保往，復請追擊。

translations.literal: Later when I followed Yubao, I again requested pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when I followed Yubao, I again asked to pursue.

sentences.zh: 玉保止發兵五十，至庫隴癸嶺，僅餘二十人，駝复乏。

translations.literal: Yubao only sent fifty troops; reaching Kulonggui Ridge there were only twenty men left, and camels were also exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Yubao sent only fifty men; by the time we reached Kulonggui Ridge only twenty remained, and our camels were exhausted as well.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納於師行日已過嶺竄哈薩克。

translations.literal: Amursana had already crossed the ridge and fled into Kazakh lands on the day the army marched.
translations.idiomatic: Amursana had already crossed the ridge and fled into Kazakh lands on the very day our army set out.

sentences.zh: 」上以其言實，貸死，授三等侍衛，在乾清門行走。

translations.literal: The Emperor found his words true, commuted death, appointed him Third Class Bodyguard, and ordered him to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor found his account truthful, spared his life, appointed him Third Class Bodyguard, and ordered him to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 尋仍遣赴軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was again sent to the army.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent back to the army.

sentences.zh: 定邊將軍兆惠招降布勒特部頭目圖魯啟拜，令烏勒登自珠木罕至圖固斯塔老宣詔，護降人入覲。

translations.literal: Frontier General Zhao Hui received the surrender of Burut leader Turuqibai and ordered Wu Leideng from Zhumuhan to Tugustalao to proclaim the edict and escort surrenderees to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier General Zhao Hui received the submission of the Burut leader Turuqibai and ordered Wu Leideng to travel from Zhumuhan to Tugustalao proclaiming the edict and escorting the surrenderees to audience.

sentences.zh: 擢頭等侍衛，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to First Class Bodyguard and appointed Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to First Class Bodyguard and appointed a grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 令捕瑪哈沁，並截霍集占逃路。

translations.literal: He was ordered to capture Mahaqin and also cut off Huojizhan's escape route.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to capture Mahaqin and also block Huojizhan's line of escape.

sentences.zh: 尋以捕瑪哈沁不力，令在領隊大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Soon for inefficiency in capturing Mahaqin he was ordered to serve in the rank above commanding officer.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, for failing to capture Mahaqin effectively, he was ordered to serve in a rank above commanding officer.

sentences.zh: 師還，累遷鑲黃旗蒙古都統、左翼前鋒統領。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was promoted in succession to Mongol Commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the Left Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he rose through successive promotions to Mongol commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the Left Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：從兆惠、富德討霍集占有功諸將校，若瑚爾起、愛隆阿殲敵搴旗，見於詠歌，厥績懋焉。

translations.literal: Commentary: Of the various officers and commanders who followed Zhao Hui and Fude against Huojizhan and achieved merit, such as Hu Erqi and Ai Long'a who annihilated the enemy and seized standards, celebrated in verse — their achievements were grand indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Among the officers who followed Zhao Hui and Fude against Huojizhan and won distinction, men such as Hu Erqi and Ai Long'a, who annihilated the enemy and seized battle standards and were celebrated in verse, achieved truly outstanding merit.

sentences.zh: 舒明逐叛拊降，以勞受爵。

translations.literal: Shu Ming pursued rebels and comforted surrenderees, receiving a fief for his labors.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Ming pursued rebels and comforted those who surrendered, receiving a noble rank for his labors.

sentences.zh: 福祿、努三與呼爾璊之役，齊里克齊佐色勒庫爾之戰，相師助庫車之圍，伊柱收伊西洱之降，錄功皆居最，抑亦其次也。

translations.literal: Fu Lu and Nu San at the Hur'eren campaign, Qi Likeqi assisting at the Sileku'er battle, Xiangshi helping at the siege of Kucha, Yi Zhu receiving surrenders at Yixier — all recorded for merit at the top rank; yet these were still second to the first.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lu and Nu San at the battle of Hur'eren, Qi Likeqi at Sileku'er, Xiangshi at the siege of Kucha, and Yi Zhu receiving the surrenders at Yixier — all were recorded among the foremost in merit, yet still ranked below those first two.
